observation.visible_scene: A close-up of a curved, footed glass filled with a golden, carbonated liquid (beer-like) topped by a white foamy head, set against a dark background with a reddish, reflective tabletop visible on the left. A thin vertical stream of liquid enters the glass from the top center. The glass and the background keep the same position in every frame, indicating a stationary camera.
visible_changes: A thin pour stream remains visible at the top center throughout the excerpt, indicating an ongoing fill rather than a start or stop.
Small bubbles continuously rise and shift within the golden liquid, changing the internal sparkle pattern from frame to frame.
The white foam head at the top shows subtle texture/height changes (settling and re-bubbling) while staying present the whole time.
The overall liquid/foam level relative to the glass rim stays roughly constant, near the top of the frame, with no large rise or fall evident.
The glass, its bright base reflections, and the dark/red background do not translate or deform; their positions are stable across all frames.
outside_clip_unknowns: When the pour began before this segment and when/whether it ends after it.
The source or spout producing the stream (cut off above the frame).
The final fill level or foam outcome after the excerpt.
The exact identity of the liquid and the setting beyond the visible tabletop.
uncertain_details: Whether the foam head is slowly thinning or merely fluctuating in texture; the change is subtle.
Whether the liquid level rises measurably during the clip or is essentially at a steady near-full state.
Whether the top stream is perfectly continuous or momentarily breaks between sampled frames.
